given: A malicious guest holds a WS connection and crafts a channel_action carrying another tenant's meeting_id.
when: The crafted message (foreign meeting_id, plus a variant with an oversized 3000-char arg and an unregistered type) hits the one dispatch funnel.
then: The funnel rate-limits, Pydantic-validates once (UUID + Field(max_length) + Literal reject the oversized/malformed variants), resolves entity->owner->tenant from OUR store (never the client's id), and refuses with a generic 'Not found' — routing nothing and never reading the other tenant's code.
